stages.native: SELECT b."Row ID" AS "Borrower ID",b."Description" AS "Borrower",m.reliability_score AS "Score",m.relative_contribution AS "Value ×",m.confidence AS "History",m.arrangement_status AS "Schedule",h.overdue_amount AS "Overdue ฿" FROM public.reporting_borrower_matrix_v3 m JOIN public.reporting_borrower_payment_health_v1 h USING(borrower_id) JOIN public.olap_borrowers_analytics b ON b."Row ID"=m.borrower_id WHERE m.quadrant='Cash Cow' ORDER BY m.contribution_30d DESC,m.borrower_id

SELECT b."Row ID" AS "Borrower ID",b."Description" AS "Borrower",m.reliability_score AS "Score",m.relative_contribution AS "Value ×",m.confidence AS "History",m.arrangement_status AS "Schedule",h.overdue_amount AS "Overdue ฿" FROM public.reporting_borrower_matrix_v3 m JOIN public.reporting_borrower_payment_health_v1 h USING(borrower_id) JOIN public.olap_borrowers_analytics b ON b."Row ID"=m.borrower_id WHERE m.quadrant='Star' ORDER BY m.contribution_30d DESC,m.borrower_id

SELECT b."Row ID" AS "Borrower ID",b."Description" AS "Borrower",m.reliability_score AS "Score",m.relative_contribution AS "Value ×",m.confidence AS "History",m.arrangement_status AS "Schedule",h.overdue_amount AS "Overdue ฿" FROM public.reporting_borrower_matrix_v3 m JOIN public.reporting_borrower_payment_health_v1 h USING(borrower_id) JOIN public.olap_borrowers_analytics b ON b."Row ID"=m.borrower_id WHERE m.quadrant='Dog' ORDER BY m.contribution_30d DESC,m.borrower_id

SELECT b."Row ID" AS "Borrower ID",b."Description" AS "Borrower",m.reliability_score AS "Score",m.relative_contribution AS "Value ×",m.confidence AS "History",m.arrangement_status AS "Schedule",h.overdue_amount AS "Overdue ฿" FROM public.reporting_borrower_matrix_v3 m JOIN public.reporting_borrower_payment_health_v1 h USING(borrower_id) JOIN public.olap_borrowers_analytics b ON b."Row ID"=m.borrower_id WHERE m.quadrant='Question Mark' ORDER BY m.contribution_30d DESC,m.borrower_id

SELECT b."Row ID" AS "Borrower ID",b."Description" AS "Borrower",h.has_active_loan AS "Active loan",h.current_health_status AS "Current health",h.overdue_amount AS "Overdue ฿",h.overdue_charge_count AS "Overdue charges",h.oldest_unpaid_days AS "Oldest days",h.rating_status AS "Rating status",h.reliability_score AS "Reliability /100",h.confidence AS "Confidence",coalesce(m.quadrant,'Outside active cohort') AS "Category",coalesce(m.arrangement_status,'Outside active cohort') AS "Schedule",m.classification_reason AS "Category reason",h.reason_text AS "Payment reason" FROM public.reporting_borrower_payment_health_v1 h JOIN public.olap_borrowers_analytics b ON b."Row ID"=h.borrower_id LEFT JOIN public.reporting_borrower_matrix_v3 m USING(borrower_id) ORDER BY h.overdue_amount DESC NULLS FIRST,h.oldest_unpaid_days DESC NULLS LAST,h.borrower_id

questions.name: Reliability components & effective weights · active borrowers

stages.native: SELECT b."Row ID" AS "Borrower ID",b."Description" AS "Borrower",h.rating_status AS "Status",h.reliability_score AS "Final /100",h.raw_score AS "Raw /100",h.recent_score AS "Recent /100",h.recent_effective_weight AS "Recent weight",h.older_score AS "Older /100",h.older_effective_weight AS "Older weight",h.delay_score AS "Delay /100",h.delay_effective_weight AS "Delay weight",h.current_score AS "Current /100",h.current_effective_weight AS "Current weight",h.score_cap_applied AS "Cap applied",h.recent_on_time_count AS "Recent on time",h.recent_obligation_count AS "Recent observations",h.history_span_days AS "History days",h.confidence AS "Confidence" FROM public.reporting_borrower_matrix_v3 m JOIN public.reporting_borrower_payment_health_v1 h USING(borrower_id) JOIN public.olap_borrowers_analytics b ON b."Row ID"=m.borrower_id ORDER BY h.reliability_score ASC NULLS FIRST,h.borrower_id

questions.name: Unavailable ratings & default context · all borrowers

stages.native: SELECT b."Row ID" AS "Borrower ID",b."Description" AS "Borrower",h.has_active_loan AS "Active loan",h.rating_status AS "Status",h.data_quality_status AS "Data quality",h.default_count AS "Default count",h.recorded_default_loss AS "Recorded loss ฿",h.overdue_amount AS "Overdue ฿",h.reason_text AS "Reason" FROM public.reporting_borrower_payment_health_v1 h JOIN public.olap_borrowers_analytics b ON b."Row ID"=h.borrower_id WHERE h.rating_status<>'Rated' ORDER BY h.borrower_id

SELECT b."Row ID" AS "Borrower ID",b."Description" AS "Borrower",s.arrangement_status AS "Schedule",s.modified_schedule_loan_count AS "Restricted loans",s.active_loan_count AS "Active loans",s.expected_interest_30d AS "Expected interest ฿",s.recorded_interest_30d AS "Recorded interest ฿",s.interest_coverage_30d AS "Interest coverage",s.interest_date_coverage_30d AS "Date coverage",m.payment_only_quadrant AS "Payment-only category",m.quadrant AS "Category" FROM public.reporting_borrower_schedule_health_v1 s JOIN public.reporting_borrower_matrix_v3 m USING(borrower_id) JOIN public.olap_borrowers_analytics b ON b."Row ID"=s.borrower_id ORDER BY s.arrangement_gate DESC,b."Description"

questions.name: Modified schedules · loan and next-plan detail

stages.native: SELECT b."Row ID" AS "Borrower ID",b."Description" AS "Borrower",s.start_date AS "Loan date",s.payment_interval AS "Normal interval days",s.daily_interest AS "Daily interest ฿",s.comparison_start AS "Compared from",s.expected_interest_30d AS "Expected interest ฿",s.recorded_interest_30d AS "Recorded interest ฿",s.expected_due_dates_30d AS "Expected dates",s.recorded_interest_dates_30d AS "Recorded dates",s.schedule_reason AS "Rule reason",s.next_plan_due_date AS "Next plan due",s.next_plan_interest AS "Next interest ฿",s.next_plan_principal AS "Next principal ฿" FROM public.reporting_loan_schedule_health_v1 s JOIN public.olap_borrowers_analytics b ON b."Row ID"=s.borrower_id WHERE s.modified_schedule ORDER BY b."Description",s.start_date,s.loan_id

questions.name: Matrix borrowers · scores, schedule and contribution

stages.native: SELECT b."Row ID" AS "Borrower ID",b."Description" AS "Borrower",p.quadrant AS "Category",p.reliability_score AS "Payment score /100",p.arrangement_status AS "Schedule",p.relative_contribution AS "Contribution ×",p.contribution_30d AS "Interest 30d ฿",p.outstanding_principal AS "Principal ฿",p.confidence AS "History",p.plot_status AS "Plot status",p.position_basis AS "Position basis",p.classification_reason AS "Category reason",p.reporting_date AS "As of" FROM public.reporting_borrower_matrix_plot_v1 p JOIN public.olap_borrowers_analytics b ON b."Row ID"=p.borrower_id ORDER BY CASE p.quadrant WHEN 'Star' THEN 1 WHEN 'Question Mark' THEN 2 WHEN 'Cash Cow' THEN 3 WHEN 'Dog' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END,b."Description",p.borrower_id
